decisive_failure: value: Despite genuine target derivation and novelty, the headline is not independently worth retrieving: (a) only observes both Remark 5.10 seeds lie on the same nonconstant side of the published dichotomy, so Cor 5.7/5.8 inapplicability is visible from theorem hypotheses without a new invariant; (b) is elementary product-minus-wedge combinatorics evaluated by math.comb for N=2,3,4 with admittedly no theorem lifting to Cu, advertised only as a speculative foothold with per-level entropy gap.
